items.title: Another day of survival for a family in Ukraine
items.description: On the outskirts of Kyiv, one family prepares for the fifth winter of war against Russia -- stockpiling food and fuel and trying to maintain as much a sense of normalcy as possible.

items.title: Russian Strike on Kryvyi Rih Wounds 58, Kills 7-Year-Old and Paramedic
items.description: A Russian ballistic missile strike on central Kryvyi Rih, a city in Ukraine’s Dnipropetrovsk region, on Friday evening, Nov. 20, killed a 7-year-old boy and a 20-year-old paramedic and injured 58 people, including four children, local officials said. items.title: Yemen's Houthis target Riyadh after Saudi coalition's 'special operation'
items.description: Yemen's Houthi rebels launched strikes on Riyadh on Saturday after Saudi-led coalition air raids on Yemen, escalating a months-long surge in cross-border attacks.

items.title: At Least 9 Killed In Russian Attacks On Ukraine, Kyiv Bridges Damaged
items.description: At least nine people were killed and 28 injured on November 20 in an overnight Russian drone and ballistic missile attack on Ukraine. In Kyiv, damaged bridges have been partially closed to traffic, forcing residents to cross the Dnieper River on foot. Strikes also hit other regions.

items.title: ‘You will not be alone’: General Assembly President tells Rohingya refugees after genocide ruling
items.description: A day after the UN’s highest court found that Myanmar had committed genocide against the Rohingya, the President of the General Assembly visited the refugee camps in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh, urging the world to turn the landmark judgement into action.

items.title: Step toward accountability: Top UN court finds Myanmar guilty of Rohingya genocide
items.description: Rohingya refugees around the world welcomed the ruling, which comes after a yearslong legal battle and decades of persecution in western Myanmar.

items.title: Putin proposes second humanitarian ceasefire — is it a trap?
items.description: Russian President Putin has suggested evacuating civilians from the embattled Ukrainian city of Kostiantynivka. But experts warn this could serve military, not humanitarian, aims. What should Kyiv do?

items.description: The three men are due to meet on Thursday and potentially discuss Russia's war with Ukraine and the U.S. war in Iran, as well as other flashpoints.
